_doc: Which skill folders a box must NOT carry. Every box pulls all of main; harness/bin/desk.py apply (run by the SessionStart hook) hides the listed folders on the boxes whose identity matches, via git sparse-checkout, so a pull can never bring them back. Identity = hostname / COMPUTERNAME / local username / harness/.operator slug, matched case-insensitively as a substring. Edit, commit, push - the box applies it on its next session.
_doc_drafts_only: Desks that may BUILD a draft but must never press Add. Three things read this list: `sapb1 add-draft` refuses outright on these boxes (sap-b1/cli/internal/config/desk.go), the SessionStart hook puts the policy in the AI's context (harness/bin/desk.py policy), and the exclude rule below takes the submit skill off the box. Same identity matching as `exclude`. Add a desk here when the operator submits and posts the documents herself.

drafts_only.note: Mahak - GRPO desk. Nothing from this desk reaches the approver: `add-draft` is refused, and a GRPO is POSTED LIVE rather than drafted (`sapb1 post PurchaseDeliveryNotes`), because a drafted GRPO lands in Bhawani's queue and SAP refuses this login a GRPO draft in JIVO_MART anyway (-6006). Every other doctype still stops at the draft and the operator presses Add herself in the SAP B1 client. Daman 2026-09-03, GRPO route changed 2026-09-04.

Shahrukh - SAP data entry, always through USER07 (HARSH) by Daman's instruction 2026-09-09 ("only give him user 07", "always draft pls"). Drafts-only because USER07 is named on ZERO Always-terms approval templates (OWTM.Conds='N') in ANY of the three books - checked live 2026-09-09: Oil has only 67 Delivery + 103 API AP AUTO (USER39), Mart only 48, Bev only 39/46/68, and none list USER07. With no template SAP does not submit, it POSTS LIVE and unapproved (C-0034). So `add-draft` must never run here; a human presses Add in the SAP B1 client.

Vishal (VISHAL TYAGI) - RM/PM entry desk, accounts-centric, always through USER07 (HARSH). Daman 2026-09-09: "he will be RMPM, basically account-centric from user 7 only". Drafts-only for the same reason as Shahrukh: USER07 is named on ZERO Always-terms approval templates (OWTM.Conds='N') in any of the three books, so `add-draft` would not submit - SAP would POST IT LIVE and unapproved (C-0034). His own login USER22 (InternalKey 31) IS an originator on the delivery templates (Oil 67, Bev 46), but it is not used on this box and the guard is per-box, not per-doctype. A human presses Add in the SAP B1 client.

Priya - GRPO desk (HR-IT), SAP login USER19 (GURCHARAN, InternalKey 28). Daman 2026-09-09: "she will be mainly responsible for putting up the GRPOs". Drafts-only because NO Always-terms approval template (OWTM.Conds='N') covers a GRPO (TransType 20) in ANY of the three books - checked live 2026-09-09: Oil has only 67 Delivery (15) + 103 API AP AUTO (18), Mart only 48 (18), Bev only 39/46 Delivery (15) + 68 (18), and USER19 is an originator on none of them. With no template SAP does not submit, it POSTS LIVE and unapproved (C-0034). And per Daman 2026-09-08 a GRPO is never live-posted either - `post PurchaseDeliveryNotes` is off. So this desk BUILDS the draft and a human presses Add in the SAP B1 client. Note USER19 is shared with Mahak (PC-AUDIT-05), so SAP cannot tell their work apart.
